verdict.rationale: Bland documents an official MCP server that lets any AI agent operate a Bland account through natural language: placing and inspecting calls, sending texts, building and validating pathways, managing agents, querying analytics and running evals. A probe independently confirms this MCP documentation exists, and Bland also documents a recommended plugin plus an agent-driven onboarding flow. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface (natural-language operation is only shown through external AI agents), and independent hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operations work as described.
